{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Identify completed orders with missing revenue
non_numeric_completed = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue'].isna())]

# Check the revenue values for all completed orders (including those with non-numeric entries)
all_completed_revenue = df[df['status'] == 'completed']['revenue']

# Compute mean including non-numeric rows as NaN (i.e., exclude them)
mean_excluding_missing = all_completed_revenue.mean()

# Now, check if the missing revenue values are systematically different
# We can compare the mean revenue of completed orders with non-missing revenue to the overall mean
completed_with_revenue = all_completed_revenue.dropna()
mean_with_revenue = completed_with_revenue.mean()

# Calculate the difference
difference = mean_excluding_missing - mean_with_revenue

# Also check if the missing rows have any pattern in other columns
pattern_check = non_numeric_completed[['customer_segment', 'channel', 'customer_age']].describe()

mean_excluding_missing, mean_with_revenue, difference, pattern_check"}
